title: Blushing dusty nebula
caption: Part of the Iris Nebula, NGC 7023, imaged by the Hubble Space Telescope
celestial: HD 200775, NGC 7023 · constellation Cepheus · about 1400 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESA/Hubble press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: Thick mounds of dust billow like cotton across this close-up, lit from above by the nearby star HD 200775, with background and foreground stars dotted throughout. The area lies in the northwest of the large Iris Nebula, which seems to be clogged with dust.

That dust is not like the dust at home. It is made of tiny particles of solid matter, ten to a hundred times smaller than household dust grains. Because the dust scatters the light of the nearby star, the cloud shines by reflected starlight rather than glowing on its own.

Researchers studying the Iris are especially interested in one region, to the left of and slightly above the center of the image. There, dusty filaments look redder than expected. Such an unexpected color can hint that the dust grains or the conditions around them are different from what astronomers assume, though the caption does not say what the explanation is.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (3.32 x 3.21 arcminutes) and distance (1400 light years), the frame spans roughly 1.4 × 1.3 light-years. Its light set out about 1,400 years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: This image comes from Hubble's Advanced Camera for Surveys, combining blue, green, near-infrared and hydrogen-alpha filters. The source does not publish which color was assigned to each filter.
understand.eye: Part of the data is near-infrared, invisible to the eye, and the faint reflected light from the dust needs long exposures to show up.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

explore: The image is oriented with north down and east to the right, and the field of view is 3.3 arcminutes. It combines four images taken through blue, green, near-infrared and hydrogen-alpha filters.
alt: Billowing, cotton-like mounds of dust lit from above by a bright star, with stars scattered throughout.
